x-e-e6-03.title: Ingaba ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele? Ukutshintsha isigwebo sakho njengoko ubungqina bukhula

x-e-e6-04.title: Ukwenza iitheyibhile ukufumana amatyala apho isibhengezo siyinyaniso
x-e-e6-04.goal: Yenza iitheyibhile ezininzi zeevoti wena apho isibhengezo sesiNgesi 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' siyinyaniso.
x-e-e6-04.material: Abafundi abangama-20 kwiklasi enye nganye bavotela intshukumo emva kwexesha lesnack: ibhola yonyawo, ubugcisa, okanye umculo. Iivoti ziyabizwa ngokuba zi-s (ibhola yonyawo), a (ubugcisa), kunye ne-m (umculo).
x-e-e6-04.thinking.0: Ukwahlula umahluko phakathi kwe 'most' ne 'more than half'
x-e-e6-04.thinking.1: Ukwenza imizekelo enelisa iimeko ezininzi ngaxeshanye
x-e-e6-04.prereq.1: Iintsingiselo ze most, fewer than, half
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.prompt: Isiphumo kwakuyi-ibhola yonyawo iivoti ezi-8, ubugcisa iivoti ezi-6, umculo iivoti ezi-6. Sesiphi isivakalisi esichaza oko ngokuchanekileyo kakhulu?
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Dibanisa i-8, 6, kunye ne-6, fumana isiqingatha sabafundi abangama-20, uze uthelekise.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.a: Jonga ukuba zombini iimeko ziqinisekisiwe ngamanani.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.c: Thelekisa kwakhona ukuba i-8 inkulu okanye incinci kune-10.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.explain: Iivoti ezi-8 zininzi kuneebugcisa (6) nomculo (6), ngoko zezona zininzi, kwaye zincinci kune-10, isiqingatha sama-20, ngoko asiyisiqingatha. Ngoko a ilungile.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.prompt: Yenza iitheyibhile ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo zeevoti ezinesixa sabafundi abangama-20 apho isibhengezo esifanayo ('soccer got the most votes, but not half') siyinyaniso.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ibhola yonyawo kufuneka ibe nezona zininzi, ngoko qala ngokukhetha ixabiso elikhulu kuneebugcisa nomculo.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Lungisa ibhola yonyawo kwixabiso elinye, uze ususe kwama-20 wahlule eseleyo phakathi kobugcisa nomculo. Ukuba ibhola yonyawo incinci kakhulu, awukwazi ukufikelela kwama-20.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Iivoti ziinani eziphelele ezingu-0 okanye ngaphezulu.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Bhala iivoti njengamanani aphelele angu-0 okanye ngaphezulu.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Ibhola yonyawo ayinazo ezininzi kunobugcisa okanye umculo.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.explain: Ukuze ibhola yonyawo ibe nezona zininzi, ubugcisa nomculo kufuneka zibe zincinci kune-s nganye, kwaye isixa sazo yi-20-s. Ukuba s=7, ngoko a+m=13, ngoko azinakuba zombini zi-6 okanye ngaphantsi, ngoko isilela, kwaye ukuba s ingu-10 okanye ngaphezulu iyisiqingatha. Ngoko s inokuba ngu-8 okanye 9 kuphela.

x-e-e6-01.goal: Kumbhalo womnqweno ka-Jin, hlula umnqweno ngokwawo, izizathu, imizekelo esebenza njengobungqina, neentetho ezingaphandle kwesihloko, uze ugweba ngesiNgesi ukuba sesiphi sona isizathu esinamandla kakhulu.
x-e-e6-01.material:
Iklasi 6-3 ixoxa ngo "Should we keep a class pet?" Nanku umbhalo ka-Jin.

I think we should get a class pet. A pet can teach us to take care of animals. I like cats very much, and I want to see one every day. Class 6-1 had a fish last year, and students fed it by turns. Also, many students are afraid of dogs.
